event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Approx.4.2 nm northwest from Pulau Cula, Indonesia, eastbound lane of the Traffic Separation Scheme Indonesia 01° 02.73' N

sources.title: Piracy monthly report November 2024
sources.text: While underway, five perpetrators armed with metal rods were sighted in the engine room. The alarm was raised and all crew mustered to conduct a search. The crew members were accounted for and there were no injuries. Nothing was stolen from the ship. The master reported the incident to the Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS). Safety navigational broadcast was initiated. The Republic of Singapore Navy's (RSN) Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF) and Singapore
